title: Taking a Step When Pushed: The Capture Point, Where a Foot Must Land, and How the Time to Get It There Limits the Push That Can Be Answered

questions.question: What is the capture point?
options: The place on the ground over which the body would come to rest, x plus v times the time constant
questions.explanation: A foot put there catches it.

questions.question: A push of 0.30 m/s put the capture point how far out?
questions.explanation: And the foot had to land 24.5 cm out, after a swing of 0.25 s.

questions.question: Why must the foot land further than the capture point of the push?
options: The capture point runs away exponentially while the foot is in the air

questions.question: The largest push that could be answered with a swing of 0.35 s:
Why is a fast swing worth so much?
options: The capture point grows exponentially with the swing time
questions.explanation: Each tenth of a second costs a large share.

questions.question: When is a step the right answer?
options: When the push is beyond what the feet's moments can answer (35-05)
questions.explanation: Small pushes by forces, large ones by a step.
